findings.issue: Implementation hint line 126 states '@Recurring and @Job annotations from org.jobrunr.jobs.annotations package'. This is incorrect for @Recurring. In JobRunr 6.x/7.x, @Job lives in org.jobrunr.jobs.annotations, but @Recurring lives in org.jobrunr.scheduling.annotations.Recurring. An implementor following this hint verbatim will use the wrong import for @Recurring, causing a compile error or using the wrong annotation.
findings.fix: Split the hint into two: '@Job annotation is from org.jobrunr.jobs.annotations.Job; @Recurring annotation is from org.jobrunr.scheduling.annotations.Recurring. Verify exact packages after adding the jobrunr-spring-boot-3-starter dependency.'

findings.issue: Step 1 instructs to 'Update Session management section' in architecture.md to reflect spring-session-data-mongodb. No such section exists in the current architecture.md. The file has: Tech Stack, Project Structure, Key Dependencies, Data Model, External Integrations, and Data Flow sections. The auth module description in Project Structure mentions 'auth (JWT, session)' inline — there is no standalone Session management section to update. An agent following this instruction will either misinterpret it (modifying the wrong section) or fail to act on it.
findings.fix: Replace 'Update Session management section' with: 'In the Project Structure section, update the auth module description from auth (JWT, session) to auth (spring-session-data-mongodb, session). If needed, add a brief note in Key Dependencies Backend section that session management uses spring-session-data-mongodb, not JWT.'

findings.issue: Task 8 frontmatter declares depends_on: [6, 7], but the Dependencies section says 'None from backend — this is parallel to Tasks 8-9 in wave 5'. The depends_on [6, 7] is structurally correct per the tech-spec (wave 5 runs after wave 4), but the inline comment is self-referential and misleading: 'parallel to Tasks 8-9' should be 'parallel to Task 9'. This creates minor confusion for agents reading the task but does not block implementation.
findings.fix: Change Dependencies note to: 'None from backend — this task is parallel to Task 9 in wave 5. Requires Node/pnpm environment.'

findings.issue: Details section 'Sessions collection field path verification' (lines 116-121) contains a full code block showing the expected session document JSON schema and a specific reactiveMongoTemplate.findAll(Document.class, "sessions").blockFirst() call. While framed as 'verify this', it prescribes a specific imperative debugging technique including the full method chain. This is borderline prescriptive. The schema shown is a reasonable hint about expected structure, but the .blockFirst() debugging approach is an implementation prescription rather than a pattern pointer.
findings.fix: Acceptable as-is given the nature of the verification task — keep the schema example but note it as indicative only. No critical change needed; acceptability judgment is the reviewer's.

findings.issue: Task 7 ProfileService uses EventService for logging password_changed and account_deleted events (lines 34, 37), and EventService.java is created in Task 4. EventService.java is not listed in Context Files, making it harder for the implementing agent to see the EventService API without looking it up. The dependency is noted in the Dependencies section but not surfaced as a readable context file.
